caption:
Stop memorizing the cone formula for the SAT.

Circle, rectangle and triangle area plus prism, cylinder, sphere, cone and pyramid volume are all on the reference sheet. Spend your memory on what isn't.

Save this for your next study session.
tiktok_caption: Area and volume formulas are on the SAT reference sheet. Stop memorizing them.

youtube.title: SAT Reference Sheet: Formulas You Don't Need to Memorize
youtube.description: The SAT math reference sheet gives the main area and volume formulas, so save your memory for the ones it leaves out.
